run_pipeline_depth_estimation: run the MarigoldDepthPipeline to predict monocular depth maps from input images
create_pipeline_instance: create a MarigoldDepthPipeline instance with unet, vae, scheduler, text_encoder, and tokenizer
ensemble_depth_maps: ensemble multiple depth predictions with scale and shift invariant alignment and uncertainty estimation
prepare_image_latents: prepare image latents and prediction latents for the diffusion denoising loop
decode_prediction_latents: decode prediction latents from latent space back to pixel-space depth maps
